about.heading: About Me
about.title: Who Am I?
about.intro: Hey I'm Degly Pava, an XR technology evangelist, cross-platform XR & wearable engineer, and developer-relations mentor based in Tokyo, Japan. I build production-ready spatial experiences across Unity, OpenXR, visionOS, WebXR, AR glasses, and mobile XR while representing technology publicly, guiding developer ecosystems, and supporting cross-regional partnerships.
about.summary: XR Technology Evangelist • Meta Horizon Start Mentor • MIT Reality Hack Mentor • Global Developer Mentor • Meta Ray-Ban Display WebApps • XREAL LBE • DEN-NOH Vision

detailed.paragraph1: My work spans smart glasses, wearables, mobile AR, WebXR, and large-scale spatial installations across Japan, the US, Europe, and Latin America. I've worked with CAPCOM and Nintendo, led AR development for Universal Studios Japan, and helped represent XR technology through public demos, speaking, and partner-facing ecosystem work.
detailed.paragraph2: I directly planned and developed Meta Ray-Ban Display WebApps, XREAL large-scale location-based entertainment deployments, and DEN-NOH Vision / Ghost in the Shell at TOKYO NODE, alongside OpenUPM packages and cross-platform tooling adopted by 15+ companies in Japan's XR market.
detailed.paragraph3: From shipping Apple Vision Pro compatibility and spatial demos at STYLY to mentoring developers around the world, speaking internationally about XR glasses, and supporting a €1.58M European XR master's program, I bridge engineering execution, developer relations, product storytelling, and global partnerships.

recruiterBridge.label: Recruiter Snapshot
recruiterBridge.text: Right after this intro, you’ll see a compact hiring summary with roles, proof, skills, and links grouped together.

snapshot.heading: Recruiter Snapshot
snapshot.title: Where I Create the Most Value
snapshot.lede: I create the most value where XR evangelism, cross-platform XR engineering, wearable product execution, developer relations, and international partnerships overlap. I can ship the experience, adapt it across devices, mentor global developer communities, and communicate the work clearly to partners, audiences, and regional ecosystems.
